_comment: PLAXIS 2D parity reference registry. See README.md for the schema and pass criterion. Values typed from the PLAXIS 2D 2025.1 Tutorial Manual (TM), Reference Manual (RM), Scientific Manual (SM) and Schweiger 2002 (BM). Sources are NOT committed; only derived numbers are. Default tolerance 0.02 (2%).

cases.title: Circular footing on sand - rigid, reaction force
cases.quantity: vertical reaction Force-Y x 2pi at prescribed uy = -0.05 m [kN]
cases.notes: Axisymmetric, 15-noded, sand MC drained E'=13e3 nu=0.3 c'=1 phi=30 psi=0, 4 m layer, R_model=5 m. Rigid footing via line prescribed displacement on (0,4)-(1,4). PHASE 6 FINDING: +11.6% at elem_size 1 (62 elems), converging monotonically to 588 as the mesh refines (255 elems -> +6.4% in 7.2 s; 959 elems -> +2.9% in 557 s). The residual is the footing-edge stress singularity on an axisymmetric mesh, not a model error; it cannot meet 2% AND the 5-min cap together. Phase 11 performance + inherent discretisation; reported as a measured bias.

cases.title: Circular footing on sand - flexible, capacity
cases.quantity: applied load q*pi*R^2 at qy = -188 kN/m^2 [kN]
cases.notes: Footing plate EA1=5e6 EI=8.5e3 nu=0 on (0,4)-(1,4); line load qy=-188. Node 4* at (0,4) for curve Fig 1-27.

cases.title: Circular footing - load-displacement curve (Fig 1-27)
cases.quantity: SumMstage [-] vs |u| of Node (0,4) [m]
cases.notes: Raster figure; digitise in Task 0.3.

cases.title: Embankment - drained factor of safety
cases.quantity: factor of safety (SumMsf), drained (Phase 3) [-]
cases.notes: HS embankment on clay. TM states 1.8; treated as approx -> wider band. Safety: incremental Msf=0.1, reset displacements.

cases.title: Embankment - undrained factor of safety
cases.quantity: factor of safety (SumMsf), undrained (Phase 4) [-]
cases.notes: Clay set switched to Undrained (A). TM states 1.4; approx. PHASE 11 FINDING: at the TM numerics (15-noded, 'Fine') it does not finish in 900 s on PARDISO with substol 1e-5 or 1e-4; with substol 1e-3 the build phase reports a spurious collapse at 65% of the fill (19 increments kept above tolerance) -- the HS integrator is not robust where the fill's crest reaches its unconfined strength under undrained subsoil. A 6-noded run (substol 1e-4) finishes in 155 s with FoS 1.3991, but 6-noded raises the DRAINED FoS by 4.3% (1.9289 vs 1.8500), so that match is NOT accepted as verification. Open: HS integrator robustness (kernel work).

cases.title: Submerged excavation - wall moment / struct forces
cases.quantity: wall bending moment M [kNm/m] vs depth
cases.notes: No numeric value in text; max M shown only on the plot. Digitise Fig 3-14. Clay Undrained(A) HS with POP=5, sand drained HS.

cases.title: Rock slope - FoS before reinforcement (Ph7)
cases.quantity: factor of safety (SumMsf), Phase 7 [-]
cases.notes: Needs discontinuity gap-closure + cable/rock-bolt (Phase 7). Hoek-Brown siltstone.

cases.title: Rock slope - FoS after reinforcement (Ph8)
cases.quantity: factor of safety (SumMsf), Phase 8 [-]
cases.notes: As L04-FOS-7, after cables and backfill.

cases.title: Shield tunnel - lining forces
cases.quantity: lining bending moment M [kNm/m] vs position
cases.notes: Needs tunnel designer, line contraction, user-defined pore pressure (Phase 7). No numbers in text.

cases.title: NATM tunnel - lining moment
cases.quantity: lining bending moment M [kNm/m] vs position
cases.notes: Needs tunnel designer (free shape) + deconfinement beta-method (Phase 7).

cases.title: Tie-back wall - anchor force equals prestress
cases.quantity: node-to-node anchor force in activation phase [kN]
cases.notes: Top anchors prestressed to 500 kN; force equals prestress in the phase of activation. Second row 1000 kN. Grout body = embedded beam. Ph6 steady-state flow.

cases.title: Tie-back wall ULS - SumMsf > 1 (EC7 DA3)
cases.quantity: SumMsf of ULS phase > 1.0 [-]
cases.notes: TM: 'SumMsf just larger than 1.0 is enough'. No exact value. EC7 DA3 partial factors on tan(phi') and c'.

cases.title: Road embankment - excess pore pressure after Ph4
cases.quantity: max excess pore pressure after Phase 4 [kPa]
cases.notes: Consolidation to Minimum excess pore pressure 1 kPa (stop criterion). PHASE 6 FINDING: the stop-criterion MECHANISM is verified (a linear-elastic-clay variant reaches maxExcessPore 0.997 kPa in 0.1 s, and KV-CON-003 covers it independently), but the faithful Soft Soil UNDRAINED loading phase fails/times out (q40 timeout, q10 solve_failed) -- a Soft Soil undrained convergence + performance problem for Phase 11.

cases.title: Road embankment - final settlement (qualitative)
cases.quantity: embankment settlement [m]
cases.notes: TM: 'about one meter'. Updated-mesh phases (Ph13-16) need large-deformation (Phase 7). Qualitative check, wide band.

cases.title: Excavation and dewatering - head with/without wells
cases.quantity: groundwater head along a section, with vs without wells [m]
cases.notes: L7 model plus two extraction wells 1.5 m3/day/m, hmin 17 m.

cases.title: Cyclic footing - static vertical capacity
cases.quantity: static vertical capacity Vcap [MN]
cases.notes: Needs UDCAM-S + Cyclic accumulation tool + Drammen clay contours (Phase 9B, decision D6). Neq=6.001.

cases.title: Cyclic footing - cyclic vertical capacity
cases.quantity: cyclic vertical capacity [MN]
cases.notes: As L11-VCAP-STATIC; cyclic soil/interface set. qy=458.1 kN/m^2.

cases.title: Flow through embankment - pore pressure along section
cases.quantity: active pore pressure p_active along cross section, per step [kPa]
cases.notes: Needs Flow-only phase type + harmonic head function (Phase 7). Sand LE, k=0.02272.

cases.title: Potato field - saturation after 15 days
cases.quantity: saturation along a vertical cross section at day 15 [-]
cases.notes: Needs precipitation (time-dependent flux) + unsaturated-flow verification (Phase 7). Staring data sets.

cases.title: Rapid drawdown - FoS vs displacement
cases.quantity: SumMsf vs crest displacement [-]
cases.notes: Needs fully-coupled flow-deformation with time-dependent head function (Phase 7). No FoS values printed.

cases.title: Generator dynamics - uy vs time with/without damping
cases.quantity: vertical displacement uy vs dynamic time [m]
cases.notes: Needs dynamic point/line load with harmonic multiplier + dynamic in axisymmetry (Phase 8).

cases.title: Pile driving - maximum settlement
cases.quantity: maximum pile-top settlement [mm]
cases.notes: TM 'almost 14 mm'. Needs dynamic line load (half cycle) + dynamic in axisymmetry (Phase 8).

cases.title: Pile driving - final settlement
cases.quantity: final pile-top settlement [mm]
cases.notes: TM 'about 9.5 mm'.

cases.title: Building free vibration - dominant frequency
cases.quantity: dominant frequency from Fourier spectrum [Hz]
cases.notes: TM 'around 1 Hz'. Needs free-field/compliant-base dynamics + .smc signal (Phase 8; file 225a.smc missing, decision D7).

cases.title: Navigable lock - steady temperature field
cases.quantity: temperature at surface / bottom [K]
cases.notes: Needs thermal module (Phase 9A). 283.0 K surface, 283.4 K bottom.

cases.title: Freeze pipes - temperature at tunnel centre vs time
cases.quantity: temperature at tunnel centre vs time [K]
cases.notes: Needs thermal + freezing module (Phase 9A). Plateau near 273 K.

cases.title: Berlin sand - wall deflection, final stage (reference solution)
cases.quantity: horizontal wall displacement [mm] vs depth below surface [m]
cases.notes: Reference-solution curve is VECTOR on the BM cover page -> extractable exactly. HS parameters come from BM Part II, which is NOT in the file (decision D5). Blocked until Part II parameters are supplied. Variants: Rinter 0.8/0.5, t_virt 0.01.

cases.title: Berlin sand - wall deflection, first excavation stage
cases.quantity: horizontal wall displacement [mm] vs depth below surface [m]
cases.notes: Vector curve on BM cover. Blocked on Part II HS parameters (D5).

cases.title: Berlin sand - surface settlement, final stage
cases.quantity: vertical surface displacement [mm] vs distance from wall [m]
cases.notes: Vector curve on BM cover. Blocked on Part II HS parameters (D5).

cases.title: Berlin sand - row-1 anchor force = prestress in step 3
cases.quantity: row-1 anchor force after prestressing (step 3) [kN/m]
cases.notes: Row-1 prestress 768 kN over 2.30 m spacing = 334 kN/m (BM Fig 11 label). Blocked on full model (D5).
